entries.en: A criss-cross network of footpaths divides the small woodland.
entries.zh: 一张纵横交错的小径网把这片小树林分成了几块。

entries.en: The pilot checked the cruising speed before adjusting the controls.
entries.zh: 飞行员先检查了巡航速度，才调整操纵装置。

entries.en: We shared curried vegetables and warm bread at the kitchen table.
entries.zh: 我们在厨房的桌旁分着吃了咖喱蔬菜和热面包。

entries.en: Everything seemed cut and dried before the first meeting began.
entries.zh: 第一次会议还没开始，一切似乎就已事先安排好了。

entries.en: The novel's cut-throat hides his identity behind a stolen uniform.
entries.zh: 小说中的那个凶手用偷来的制服掩饰自己的身份。

entries.en: The sculptor gave the stone creature a daemonic grin.
entries.zh: 雕刻家让那个石头怪物露出了似魔鬼般的狞笑。

entries.en: We thought that old quarrel was dead and buried.
entries.zh: 我们以为那场旧争执早已成了往事。

entries.en: A layer of decomposed leaves lay beneath the fallen branches.
entries.zh: 折落的树枝下面有一层已经腐烂的落叶。

entries.en: The portrait shows a startled face with unusually dilated pupils.
entries.zh: 这幅肖像画出了一张受惊的脸，瞳孔异常扩大。

entries.en: Her dimpled cheeks reminded me of our childhood photographs.
entries.zh: 她带酒窝的脸颊让我想起了我们儿时的照片。

entries.en: The dimwitted villain forgets where he has hidden the treasure.
entries.zh: 那个笨蛋反派忘了自己把宝藏藏在哪里。

entries.en: The narrator recalls growing up in a dirt-poor household.
entries.zh: 叙述者回忆起自己在一个极为贫困的家庭中长大的经历。

entries.en: The numbers changed at a dizzying pace across the screen.
entries.zh: 屏幕上的数字以令人目不暇接的速度变化着。

entries.en: The form asks where the applicant is currently domiciled.
entries.zh: 表格要求填写申请人目前的定居地。

entries.en: The committee requested a double-blind study before considering the proposal.
entries.zh: 委员会要求先进行一项双盲研究，再考虑这项提议。

entries.en: Only one double-digit number appears in the final column.
entries.zh: 最后一栏中只有一个两位数。

entries.en: He felt down in the dumps after missing the audition.
entries.zh: 错过试镜后，他感到十分沮丧。

entries.en: A down-at-heel stranger asked whether the inn had any work.
entries.zh: 一个衣衫褴褛的陌生人问客栈是否有活可干。

entries.en: A dreadlocked musician tuned her guitar beside the stage.
entries.zh: 一位留着长绺发辫的女乐手在舞台旁调吉他。

entries.en: We were all dressed up, but the reception had been cancelled.
entries.zh: 我们都穿好了盛装，招待会却已取消。

entries.meaningZh: 从行驶汽车内开枪作案的
entries.en: The detective linked both clues to a drive-by murder.
entries.zh: 侦探把两条线索都与一起驾车枪杀案联系了起来。

entries.en: The drive-through café had a separate lane for collecting orders.
entries.zh: 那家提供免下车服务的咖啡馆设有一条专门的取餐车道。

entries.en: His droning voice nearly sent the whole classroom to sleep.
entries.zh: 他低沉单调的声音几乎让全班都睡着了。

entries.en: Choose the correct month from the drop-down menu above.
entries.zh: 请从上面的下拉菜单中选择正确的月份。

entries.en: As a dyed-in-the-wool city dweller, she missed the crowded streets.
entries.zh: 作为一个地道的城里人，她想念那些拥挤的街道。

entries.en: An ear-splitting whistle interrupted the announcer's final sentence.
entries.zh: 一声震耳欲聋的哨响打断了播音员的最后一句话。

entries.en: The engineer inspected the early-warning lights above the control panel.
entries.zh: 工程师检查了控制面板上方的预警灯。

entries.en: The proposal replaces a flat payment with an earnings-related allowance.
entries.zh: 这项提案以与收入挂钩的津贴取代统一金额的付款。

entries.en: An earth-moving machine stood idle beside the unfinished road.
entries.zh: 一台土方机械闲置在尚未完工的道路旁。

entries.en: The letter contained no earth-shattering news, just a change of address.
entries.zh: 信里没有什么令人震惊的消息，只是说地址变了。

entries.en: The inspection sheet lists the earthed components separately.
entries.zh: 检查表把接地的部件单独列了出来。

entries.en: The noise of earthmoving equipment drowned out our conversation.
entries.zh: 土方设备的噪声淹没了我们的谈话声。

entries.en: I wanted an eco-friendly alternative to disposable coffee cups.
entries.zh: 我想找一种一次性咖啡杯的环保替代品。

entries.en: The editing software kept my original recording in a separate folder.
entries.zh: 编辑软件把我的原始录音保存在单独的文件夹中。

entries.en: "I cannot open this effing jar," he muttered impatiently.
entries.zh: “我打不开这个该死的罐子。”他不耐烦地嘟囔道。

entries.en: We compared several energy-efficient heaters before choosing a small one.
entries.zh: 我们比较了几款高能效取暖器，最后选了一台小的。

entries.en: The newly enlisted recruits waited outside the quartermaster's office.
entries.zh: 新应募入伍的新兵们在军需官办公室外等候。

entries.meaningZh: 适用于初学者的；初级的
entries.en: An entry-level computer would be sufficient for her writing projects.
entries.zh: 一台入门级电脑就足以满足她的写作需要。

entries.en: The grammar devotes an entire chapter to the ergative.
entries.zh: 这本语法书用整整一章介绍动者格。

entries.en: The estimated cost appears beside each item on the worksheet.
entries.zh: 工作表上的每个项目旁边都列有估算费用。

entries.en: The chair gave an even-handed summary of both sides' objections.
entries.zh: 主席公正地概述了双方的反对意见。

entries.en: We water these plants every other day during summer.
entries.zh: 夏天，我们每隔一天给这些植物浇一次水。

entries.en: The shop opens daily, public holidays excepted.
entries.zh: 这家商店每天营业，公共假日除外。

entries.en: The novel reveals an extra-marital affair through a series of letters.
entries.zh: 这部小说通过一连串书信揭露了一段婚外情。

entries.en: His fair-weather friends disappeared when the business began to struggle.
entries.zh: 生意陷入困境时，那些不能共患难的朋友就消失了。

entries.en: The mountains looked far off through the morning haze.
entries.zh: 晨雾中的群山显得十分遥远。

entries.en: To conservative viewers, her costume ideas seemed far out.
entries.zh: 在保守的观众看来，她的服装构想显得很激进。

entries.en: His far-fetched explanation raised more questions than it answered.
entries.zh: 他那牵强的解释引出了更多问题，反而没解决多少疑问。

entries.en: A far-sighted librarian reserved space for a future children's room.
entries.zh: 一位有远见的图书管理员为将来的儿童阅览室预留了空间。

entries.en: The fatiguing climb left us too tired to cook dinner.
entries.zh: 那段累人的攀登让我们疲惫得连晚饭都做不动了。

entries.en: The favoured assistant always received the most comfortable assignments.
entries.zh: 那个受优待的助手总能得到最轻松的任务。

entries.en: They visited a fee-paying school before considering the local alternatives.
entries.zh: 他们先参观了一所收费学校，再考虑当地的其他选择。

entries.en: Bus stops were few and far between along that road.
entries.zh: 那条路沿途的公交车站很少，彼此相距很远。

entries.en: She chose a figure-hugging dress for the stage performance.
entries.zh: 她为舞台表演选了一条贴身连衣裙。

entries.en: That was our first ever visit to a recording studio.
entries.zh: 那是我们有生以来第一次参观录音室。

entries.en: The report described the injury as a first-degree burn.
entries.zh: 报告将该伤情描述为一度烧伤。

entries.en: The committee debated replacing its first-past-the-post voting system.
entries.zh: 委员会讨论了是否更换其得票最多者当选的投票制度。

entries.en: She insists she is fit as a fiddle and needs no help.
entries.zh: 她坚持说自己身体好得很，不需要帮忙。

entries.en: The jacket's flared sleeves caught on the narrow chair arms.
entries.zh: 夹克的喇叭袖挂在了狭窄的椅子扶手上。

entries.en: After paying the deposit, we were flat broke until Friday.
entries.zh: 交完押金后，我们身无分文，一直熬到星期五。

entries.en: I felt flattered when she asked me to introduce her book.
entries.zh: 她请我为她的书作介绍，我感到很荣幸。

entries.en: The café sells flavoured coffee alongside its usual dark roast.
entries.zh: 这家咖啡馆除了常卖的深烘咖啡，也出售调味咖啡。

entries.en: Even a great athlete is only flesh and blood.
entries.zh: 即使是伟大的运动员，也只是血肉之躯。

entries.meaningZh: 该死的〔英式口语，表不满〕
entries.en: "My flipping keys have vanished again," she complained.
entries.zh: “我那该死的钥匙又不见了。”她抱怨道。

entries.en: A fluted glass vase stood in the centre of the table.
entries.zh: 桌子中央摆着一只有凹槽的玻璃花瓶。

entries.en: Her fly-on-the-wall documentary follows the kitchen staff through a busy evening.
entries.zh: 她的纪实纪录片跟拍了厨房员工度过忙碌夜晚的过程。

entries.en: We borrowed a fold-up table for the balcony supper.
entries.zh: 为了在阳台上吃晚饭，我们借来了一张折叠桌。

entries.en: The forsaken cottage had weeds growing through its broken doorstep.
entries.zh: 那座被遗弃的小屋里，杂草从破损的门阶中长了出来。

entries.meaningZh: 方方正正的；方正牢固的
entries.en: A four-square tower rose above the low surrounding buildings.
entries.zh: 一座方正坚实的塔楼高耸于周围的低矮建筑之上。

entries.en: Water dripped steadily from the fractured pipe beneath the sink.
entries.zh: 水槽下面那根断裂的水管一直在滴水。

entries.en: The atmosphere was free and easy despite the formal invitations.
entries.zh: 虽然请柬很正式，现场的气氛却轻松随意。

entries.en: In this workshop, free-floating discussion gradually gives way to focused planning.
entries.zh: 在这个工作坊中，自由讨论逐渐转向了有重点的规划。

entries.en: A free-standing shelf separates the sleeping area from the kitchen.
entries.zh: 一个独立式置物架把睡觉的区域与厨房隔开。

entries.en: The match will appear on a free-to-air channel this evening.
entries.zh: 这场比赛今晚将在一个免费电视频道播出。

entries.en: The bakery was fresh out of rolls when we arrived.
entries.zh: 我们到达时，那家面包店的面包卷刚好卖完了。

entries.meaningZh: 重要的；适合刊登头版的
entries.en: The editor doubted whether the announcement deserved front-page coverage.
entries.zh: 编辑怀疑这则公告是否值得在头版报道。

entries.en: The backup generator remains fuelled by diesel rather than gas.
entries.zh: 备用发电机仍以柴油而非燃气为燃料。

entries.en: She found the mentoring role more fulfilling than she had expected.
entries.zh: 她觉得担任导师比自己原先预想的更有满足感。

entries.en: The children were full of beans after their afternoon nap.
entries.zh: 孩子们午睡后精神十足。

entries.en: I am full up, so please save that pie for tomorrow.
entries.zh: 我吃饱了，请把那份馅饼留到明天吧。

entries.en: The museum notice warns visitors about full-frontal nudity in one painting.
entries.zh: 博物馆的告示提醒参观者，一幅画中有正面全裸形象。

entries.en: The school turned a short sketch into a full-on stage production.
entries.zh: 学校将一段短剧扩展成了一部完整的舞台作品。

entries.en: A full-throated cheer greeted the runners as they entered the stadium.
entries.zh: 跑步选手进入体育场时，迎接他们的是响亮的欢呼声。

entries.en: I am not fussed about the colour if the size is right.
entries.zh: 只要尺寸合适，我不在意颜色。

entries.en: Gale-force winds rattled the shutters throughout the night.
entries.zh: 大风整夜把百叶窗吹得咔嗒作响。

entries.en: The problem turned out to be a garden-variety spelling mistake.
entries.zh: 结果发现，问题只是一个普通的拼写错误。

entries.en: The laboratory kept genetically modified seeds in a separate labelled cabinet.
entries.zh: 实验室把转基因种子单独存放在一个贴有标签的柜子里。

entries.en: A giant-sized sandwich filled almost the entire picnic basket.
entries.zh: 一个超大的三明治几乎占满了整个野餐篮。

entries.en: The boxer ducked but still took a glancing blow.
entries.zh: 拳击手俯身躲闪，却仍被斜擦了一下。

entries.en: We ate breakfast on the glassed-in porch despite the rain.
entries.zh: 虽然下着雨，我们还是在四周用玻璃围住的门廊里吃了早饭。

entries.en: The dancer crossed the stage with a smooth gliding movement.
entries.zh: 舞者以平滑的滑行步穿过舞台。

entries.en: The gold-plated watch looked expensive beneath the shop lights.
entries.zh: 那块镀金手表在店内灯光下显得很昂贵。

entries.en: He peered over his gold-rimmed glasses at the tiny signature.
entries.zh: 他从金边眼镜上方望过去，仔细看那个小小的签名。

entries.en: The grass-roots campaign began with neighbours sharing a single petition.
entries.zh: 这场基层运动始于邻居们共同传阅的一份请愿书。

entries.en: She tucked a strand of greying hair beneath her hat.
entries.zh: 她把一缕渐渐变灰的头发塞进帽子里。

entries.en: She offered a grounded assessment rather than another unsupported prediction.
entries.zh: 她给出了一份有依据的评估，而不是又一个缺乏根据的预测。

entries.en: The seller offered a guaranteed delivery date in writing.
entries.zh: 卖家以书面形式给出了保证送达的日期。

entries.en: The gun-shy dog trembled when the distant shooting began.
entries.zh: 远处开始响起枪声时，那只怕枪声的狗发起了抖。

entries.en: The final farewell was the most gut-wrenching scene in the play.
entries.zh: 最后的告别是这出戏中最令人痛苦的一幕。

entries.en: His hair-trigger temper made even a minor disagreement uncomfortable.
entries.zh: 他那一触即发的脾气让小小的意见分歧也变得令人不安。

entries.en: A hands-free headset left both her hands available for typing.
entries.zh: 免提耳机让她能腾出双手打字。

entries.en: The rules are not hard and fast; exceptions are possible.
entries.zh: 这些规则并非固定不变，可以有例外。

entries.en: She felt hard done by when the others received all the credit.
entries.zh: 当功劳全归了其他人时，她觉得自己受到了不公正的对待。

entries.en: The final chapter was hard going, even for an experienced reader.
entries.zh: 最后一章很难懂，即使有经验的读者也不例外。

entries.en: He is hard of hearing and prefers a quiet meeting place.
entries.zh: 他听力不佳，喜欢在安静的地方见面。

entries.en: The play follows a hard-drinking sailor through one disastrous weekend.
entries.zh: 这出戏讲述了一个酗酒水手在某个灾难性周末的遭遇。

entries.en: Her hard-edged review exposed weaknesses the director had overlooked.
entries.zh: 她那篇犀利的评论揭示了导演忽略的不足。

entries.meaningZh: 讲究实际的；不感情用事的
entries.en: A hard-headed shopkeeper would check the figures before making promises.
entries.zh: 一个讲究实际的店主会先核对数字，再作承诺。

entries.en: The story's hard-hearted landlord refuses even a short delay.
entries.zh: 故事中那个冷酷的房东连稍作宽限都不肯。

entries.en: These hard-wearing trousers have survived years of work in the garden.
entries.zh: 这条耐磨的裤子经受了多年园艺劳动的磨损。

entries.en: The technician traced a fault in the hard-wired control circuit.
entries.zh: 技术员查出了硬连线控制电路中的一处故障。

entries.en: One careless remark put their hard-won trust at risk.
entries.zh: 一句轻率的话让他们来之不易的信任面临风险。

entries.en: Our hare-brained plan involved moving the piano without measuring the doorway.
entries.zh: 我们那个轻率的计划竟是在不量门宽的情况下搬钢琴。

entries.en: The narrator is head over heels in love with her oldest friend.
entries.zh: 叙述者深深地爱上了与自己相识最久的朋友。

entries.en: The mayor preferred quiet repairs to another headline-grabbing announcement.
entries.zh: 比起再作一个抢眼的公告，市长更愿意默默进行修缮。

entries.en: A heart-rending letter explains why the two sisters never met again.
entries.zh: 一封令人心碎的信解释了那姐妹俩为何再也没有见面。

entries.en: Their unexpected reunion made a heart-warming ending to the story.
entries.zh: 他们意外重逢，为故事带来了一个暖心的结局。

entries.en: A heavy-set porter lifted the trunk onto a trolley.
entries.zh: 一个体格敦实的搬运工把箱子抬到了手推车上。

entries.en: She was hellbent on finishing the mural before her birthday.
entries.zh: 她铁了心要在生日之前画完那幅壁画。

entries.en: The cancelled ferry left us high and dry with all our luggage.
entries.zh: 渡轮取消了，我们带着全部行李，陷入了孤立无援的境地。

entries.en: He sounded high and mighty when he dismissed everyone's questions.
entries.zh: 他不屑地拒绝回答大家的问题，口气十分傲慢。

entries.en: The shop displayed its high-end laptops behind a glass counter.
entries.zh: 商店把高端笔记本电脑摆在玻璃柜台后面。

entries.en: A high-flying bird appeared as a dark speck above the ridge.
entries.zh: 一只高飞的鸟在山脊上方显得像个黑点。

entries.en: She carried her high-heeled shoes across the muddy courtyard.
entries.zh: 她提着高跟鞋穿过了泥泞的院子。

entries.en: The garden proved too high-maintenance for our busy household.
entries.zh: 这个花园太费精力，我们家日常忙碌，实在照料不过来。

entries.en: The box has a hinged lid and a small brass lock.
entries.zh: 这个盒子有一个带铰链的盖子和一把小铜锁。

entries.en: We found a hole-in-the-wall café behind the railway station.
entries.zh: 我们在火车站后面找到了一家狭小简陋的咖啡馆。

entries.en: Once the final inspection is over, we will be home free.
entries.zh: 只要最后的检查结束，我们就稳操胜券了。

entries.en: A hooded lamp cast a small circle of light on the desk.
entries.zh: 一盏带罩的灯在桌上投下了一小圈光。

entries.en: The team's hooped shirts were easy to spot in the crowd.
entries.zh: 球队的横条纹球衣在人群中很容易辨认。

entries.en: She was hopping mad when the repaired printer broke again.
entries.zh: 刚修好的打印机又坏了，她气得跳脚。

entries.en: His hot-headed reply turned a simple question into a quarrel.
entries.zh: 他那急躁的回答把一个简单的问题变成了争吵。

entries.en: The humming fan was the only sound in the empty office.
entries.zh: 空荡荡的办公室里只有风扇嗡嗡作响。

entries.en: They brought a humungous cake that barely fitted through the door.
entries.zh: 他们带来一个大得几乎进不了门的蛋糕。

entries.en: He gets hung up on tiny details and misses the main point.
entries.zh: 他过分纠结细枝末节，反而忽略了要点。

entries.en: The children were too hyped up to sleep after the concert.
entries.zh: 音乐会结束后，孩子们兴奋得睡不着。

entries.en: She painted the cupboard doors an ice-blue shade.
entries.zh: 她把橱柜门漆成了冰蓝色。

entries.en: He ordered iced tea and waited for his sandwich.
entries.zh: 他点了冰茶，等着自己的三明治。

entries.en: The inquiry dismissed the rumours as ill-founded speculation.
entries.zh: 调查认定那些传闻是毫无根据的猜测，予以否定。

entries.en: We arrived ill-prepared for a meeting that required detailed estimates.
entries.zh: 我们开会时准备不足，而那场会议需要详细的估算。

entries.en: She was so immersed in her drawing that she missed the doorbell.
entries.zh: 她专注于画画，连门铃声都没听见。

entries.en: The bakery is still in business after its founders retired.
entries.zh: 创办人退休后，那家面包店仍在营业。

entries.en: That generous gesture was entirely in character for her.
entries.zh: 那个慷慨的举动完全符合她的性格。

entries.en: The opening date remains in doubt until the repairs are finished.
entries.zh: 维修完工之前，开业日期仍无法确定。

entries.en: I do not buy clothes simply because they are in fashion.
entries.zh: 我不会仅仅因为衣服流行就买下来。

entries.en: After a week of repairs, the boat was in good trim.
entries.zh: 经过一周的维修，那条船已整备就绪。

entries.en: The wheels were already in motion when the gate opened.
entries.zh: 大门打开时，轮子已经在转动了。

entries.en: We are in the same boat, with neither of us holding a ticket.
entries.zh: 我们处境相同，两个人都没有票。

entries.en: The in-car display showed a route different from the paper map.
entries.zh: 车载显示屏显示的路线与纸质地图不同。

entries.en: The in-flight meal arrived just as the film was starting.
entries.zh: 电影刚开始播放，飞机上的餐食就送来了。

entries.en: The teachers attended an in-service training session on Friday.
entries.zh: 老师们星期五参加了一场在职培训。

entries.en: An in-store demonstration helped us compare the two vacuum cleaners.
entries.zh: 店内演示帮助我们比较了那两款吸尘器。

entries.en: The indented paragraph is a quotation, not the author's own comment.
entries.zh: 缩进的那一段是引文，不是作者自己的评论。

entries.en: The letter explains how her index-linked pension will be adjusted.
entries.zh: 信中解释了她与物价指数挂钩的养老金将如何调整。

entries.en: The airline's inflight entertainment included a documentary about pottery.
entries.zh: 那家航空公司的机上娱乐节目包括一部关于陶艺的纪录片。

entries.en: Her brother offered an interest-free loan to cover the deposit.
entries.zh: 她的兄弟提出借给她一笔无息贷款来付押金。

entries.en: The club became inward-looking and rarely welcomed ideas from outsiders.
entries.zh: 这个俱乐部变得封闭，很少欢迎外来者的想法。

entries.en: The balcony offered a jaw-dropping view of the canyon.
entries.zh: 从阳台望去，峡谷的景色令人惊叹。

entries.en: The cat's fur was jet black apart from one white paw.
entries.zh: 那只猫除了一只白爪子，全身的毛都是漆黑的。

entries.en: The jet-lagged visitors struggled to stay awake during dinner.
entries.zh: 那些有时差反应的来客在晚饭时困得直打瞌睡。

entries.en: The satire follows a jet-setting couple from one luxury resort to another.
entries.zh: 这部讽刺作品讲述一对生活奢华的夫妇辗转于各个豪华度假地的故事。

entries.en: A jobbing builder repaired our steps between his other small projects.
entries.zh: 一个做零活的建筑工趁其他小工程的空当修好了我们的台阶。

entries.en: I felt too keyed up to eat before my first performance.
entries.zh: 第一次登台前，我又兴奋又紧张，吃不下东西。

entries.en: The publisher rejected his kiss-and-tell memoir about a former relationship.
entries.zh: 出版社拒绝了他那本详细披露一段旧情隐私的回忆录。

entries.en: She wore knee-high boots while clearing the flooded shed.
entries.zh: 清理积水的棚屋时，她穿着及膝的靴子。

entries.en: His lah-di-dah accent vanished as soon as he became annoyed.
entries.zh: 他一生气，那种装腔作势的腔调就消失了。

entries.en: On stage, her quiet brother seemed larger than life.
entries.zh: 站在舞台上，她那沉静的兄弟显得格外不同凡响。

entries.en: Please read the last but one paragraph before answering.
entries.zh: 请在作答前阅读倒数第二段。

entries.en: The brochure promises leading-edge technology without explaining what has changed.
entries.zh: 宣传册声称采用了最先进的技术，却没解释究竟有何改进。

entries.en: The newspaper interviewed a left-of-centre candidate about local housing.
entries.zh: 报社就当地住房问题采访了一位中间偏左的候选人。

entries.en: Despite its sad opening, the novel has a life-affirming ending.
entries.zh: 尽管开篇悲伤，这部小说却有一个积极向上的结局。

entries.en: She described her weekly pottery class as a life-enhancing experience.
entries.zh: 她说每周的陶艺课是一种让生活更快乐充实的体验。

entries.en: A life-saving ring hung beside the ladder on the pier.
entries.zh: 码头上的梯子旁挂着一个救生圈。

entries.en: We could never fit a table like that into our kitchen.
entries.zh: 我们厨房绝对放不下那样的一张桌子。
